html:
Whenever there is a party some liquids are needed. Casks provide the space to store those liquids.

Casks

Name Move Walk Notes
Big Wine Cask ✗ ✗ It can be used to fill Fluid Containerss with wine.
Cask of Brown Ale ✗ ✗ A dwarf's skill in brewing ale is only exceeded by his ability to drink it.

When someone uses an Empty Beer Bottle on it, it sounds GULP, GULP, GULP and plays Yellow Music Notes.
It looks the same as a Beer Cask, a Lemonade Cask, a Cask of Brown Ale (Item), a Rum Cask, a Small Cask, a Water Cask and a Wine Cask.

Empty Super Cask ✗ ✗ It's a Super Cask that was emptied. It returns to being filled after a few seconds.
Great Health Cask ✓ ✗ It's available in the Store and can be placed inside houses and guildhouses. Use it to fill all empty vials (of any size) inside your backpack and turn them into Great Health Potions. The cask can be used to fill 1000 potions and disappears when empty.

Note: Potions filled using casks will be placed inside Your Store Inbox and will have the same restrictions as those bought from the Store, i.e. they cannot be traded, put on the ground or sold in the Market, but can be stored inside your depot.

See also: Cask & Keg Value Effectiveness

Rain Barrel (Closed) ✗ ✗ It is a closed off Rain Barrel. You can use it to open it.
Rain Barrel (Open) ✗ ✗ When water falls on a roof it can be transported via Eaves Gutters to a water barrel. Can be used to fill a container with Water (Liquid).
You can use it to open it, if it is closed.

Small Cask ✗ ✗ It contains strange red fluid that was left by lizard ancestors.

It looks the same as a Beer Cask, a Lemonade Cask, a Cask of Brown Ale, a Cask of Brown Ale (Item), a Rum Cask, a Water Cask and a Wine Cask. Part of The Ape City Quest - Mission 7: Destroying Casks.
